question: When was the Harijan Sewak Sangh founded as a result of the Poona Pact?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1932**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harijan Sevak Sangh:-**

 
 
• **It is a non-profit organization founded by Mahatma Gandhi on September 30, 1932, in Pune, India. **
 
• The organization's goal is to eradicate untouchability and uplift marginalized sections of society, such as Dalits, women, and children.
 
• The main activities of Harijan Sevak Sangh include:
 
 
• **Raising awareness against untouchability**
 
• **Socially and economically empowering Dalits**
 
• **Providing Dalits with access to education and healthcare services**
 
• **Fighting for the rights of Dalits**
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Poona Pact:-**

 
 
• ​It was an **agreement between Mahatma Gandhi and Dr. B.R. Ambedkar on behalf of Dalits, also known as depressed classes, and upper caste Hindu leaders on the reservation of electoral seats for the depressed classes in the legislature of British India in 1932.**
 
• It was made on 24 September 1932 at Yerwada Central Jail in Poona, India.
 
• It was signed by Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar on behalf of the depressed classes and by Madan Mohan Malviya on behalf of upper caste Hindus, Faraz Shah, Sana Ejaz and Gandhi.
